correctness.rationale: State symmetry gives an exact rational recurrence and correct boundary conditions. A self-contained fluid-martingale argument yields the positive vacancy density and an almost-martingale with predictable quadratic variation \((4e^c-(c+2)^2)/\beta\), giving the explicit CLT. Finite exact enumeration on 49 states and symbolic variance checks independently agree; simulations corroborate only finite behavior.
